sloka: तपो बल हतान् ज्ञात्वा वासिष्ठान् स महोदयान् ।ऋषि मध्ये महातेजा विह्वामित्रो अभ्यभाषत ॥१-६०-१॥
transliteration: tapo bala hatān jñātvā vāsiṣṭhān sa mahodayān ।ṛṣi madhye mahātejā vihvāmitro abhyabhāṣata ॥1-60-1॥

translations.english: The most brilliant Viswamitra, having destroyed the sons of Vasishta including Mahodaya by his ascetic power, said this in the midst of saints:
